hooks.command: h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/template/governance/kernel/hooks/pretooluse.py"; g="$HOME/.local/bin/gov"; [ -f "$g" ] || g="$(command -v gov)" || { echo "gov hook: no pinned gov at $HOME/.local/bin/gov or on PATH, so $h cannot run; refused" >&2; exit 2; }; read -r p < "$g"; p="${p#'#!'}"; [ -x "$p" ] || { echo "gov hook: $g names no interpreter that runs: $p, so $h cannot run; refused" >&2; exit 2; }; "$p" -E "$h"; r=$?; case $r in 0|2) exit $r;; esac; echo "gov hook: $h ended with exit $r (it could not run or crashed); refused" >&2; exit 2
